{{Quote|If you are not busy, I need someone to run a package to Sera Jossi on the outskirts.|Rroow, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:PfS" />}}
'''Rroow''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she resided in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] and worked with the [[Human/Legends|Human]] woman named [[Sera Jossi]]. The latter was investigating the reason why an entire village of Wookiees became crazy. Jossi, who did not get into town very often, got her [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] delivered by Rroow's [[Courier/Legends|couriers]].<ref name="SWG:PfS" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> when her usual courier was not around, Rroow asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to deliver the package to Jossi.<ref name="SWG:PfS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rroow was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PfS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Rroow was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees|''Rage of the Wookiees'']] on [[May 5]], [[2005]]. She could be found in Kachirho where she asked the player to deliver a package to Sera Jossi.<ref name="SWG:PfS" />
